map.零息债当期收益率？: What is the current yield of a zero-coupon bond?
map.零息债无票息，当期收益率为 0，收益全部来自到期折价的资本利得（体现在 YTM: A zero-coupon bond has no coupon, so its current yield is 0 and all the return comes from capital gain on the discount at maturity (which shows up in the YTM).
